logp.method_description: log P values of cationic [99mTc]TcN-DASD(n) were determined using the following procedure: after C18 Sep-Pak purification 0.100 mL of the solution was added to a mixture of n-octanol and PBS pH 7.4 (3 mL:3 mL). After being vortexed for 30 min, the mixture was centrifuged at 3000 rpm for 10 min. Samples (in quintuplet) from aqueous and n-octanol layers were collected and counted in a γ counter (Packard Cobra II Auto-Gamma Counter model 5001). The partition coefficients were calculated as follows: P = (activity concentration in n-octanol)/(activity concentration in PBS). The log P values were reported as an average of three different experiments ± standard deviation (SD).
